mechanism: Automated multi-agent construction of SWE training instances and distillation fine-tuning
evidence_scope: We further demonstrate the dataset's utility for training by distilling 71,498 high-quality trajectories and fine-tuning Qwen-30B-A3B-Instruct to produce Scale-SWE-Agent.
evidence_role: we propose Scale-SWE, an automated, sandboxed multi-agent workflow designed to construct high-quality SWE data at scale.
